predictions.selection_reason: Untrusted objects -> iteration over all properties -> triggers copy function for each property
predictions.source_summary: The function deepMixin accepts an object 'o' and variable arguments. The 'obj' values come from the arguments passed to deepMixin after the first argument. These are user-provided objects that get mixed into the target object 'o'.
predictions.sink_summary: The copy function assigns values directly to the target object 'o' via 'this[key] = value' (line 23) when objects are not both plain objects. This property assignment can modify the prototype chain if keys include special properties like __proto__ or constructor.
predictions.guard_summary: The isObject check (is-plain-object) validates if values are plain objects before recursive deepMixin calls, but does not protect against prototype pollution. There are no explicit guards against malicious property names that could pollute the object prototype.
predictions.risk_pattern: Untrusted objects are iterated and their properties are copied to a target object without validation of property names, enabling prototype pollution if properties like __proto__ or constructor are present.
called_function_context: forOwn (iterates over own properties of obj)
isObject (checks if value is plain object)
predictions.context_summary: The deepMixin function deeply merges objects by recursively copying properties. The candidate statement iterates over each property of source objects and copies them to the target object.
unresolved_facts: Specific version behavior of for-own and is-plain-object dependencies
Whether the module is used in contexts with attacker-controlled objects
Presence of any upstream validation before deepMixin is called

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: prototype pollution through property assignment without validation of property names like __proto__
retrieval_query.missing_control: validation of property names to prevent prototype pollution

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
top_sast_rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-1321 prototype-pollution __proto__ constructor prototype object-key property-key merge assign recursive-merge
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject prototype keys and use schema-constrained object updates.

top_sast_rules.description: When escaping special characters using a meta-character like backslash or ampersand, the meta-character has to be escaped first to avoid double-escaping, and conversely it has to be unescaped last to avoid double-unescaping.
